title: Ramsey Atlas
scope: Classical clique Ramsey numbers: 2-colour arguments through10 plus R(3,k) through15; R(3,3,k) through50; selected mixed 3-colour cases and 3-colour diagonals through10; selected 4–9-colour cases. Reported and derived endpoints are distinguished.
intervalConvention: Inclusive integer endpoints: lower <= R <= upper. A lower-bound witness has lower - 1 vertices.
methodology: The baseline is Small Ramsey Numbers revision18 (24 April2026), supplemented by primary sources checked through26 September2026. This is a curated snapshot, not an exhaustive or continuously updated database.
Two-colour upper bounds use Table Ib where it improves Table Ia. Many are unpublished computations reported in the published survey; status is shown per endpoint.
Preprints and survey-listed personal communications are retained with explicit evidence labels. Bounds are not all backed by separately peer-reviewed proof articles.

Extended three-colour entries include derived endpoints, explicitly labelled and reproducible from three-colour-seeds.json and scripts/derive-three-colour.mjs. They are valid consequences of the cited inputs, not assertions of the strongest known numerical bounds. Hypergraph, directed, size, induced, and non-clique Ramsey variants are outside scope.

Extended lower bounds incorporate an August2026 preprint and a May2026 author-reported witness. This site has not independently checked those witness graphs. For R(3,3,k), surveyed direct bounds are compared with the constructive inequality4R(3,k−1)−3 and a complete-join construction.
